items.headline: No. 1 Ohio State sees 20-point lead evaporate in 4th quarter
items.description: The No. 1 Ohio State Buckeyes controlled the game for more than three quarters, but quickly unraveled in the fourth, dropping a 24-23 decision to No. 4 Texas on Saturday night, with coach Ryan Day telling reporters afterward that "this one hurts."

items.headline: Highlight: No. 4 Texas grinds No. 1 Ohio State to a halt for epic comeback
items.description: Arch Manning throws for 196 yards and a touchdown as Hollywood Smothers score two touchdowns on the ground, including the game winner in the final minute of the 24-23 Longhorns' win.

items.headline: Week 2's best moments: Arch's defining moment, Michigan's revival and Oregon's downfall
items.description: Bounce-back performances from Texas, Michigan and Oklahoma State lead the way in Week 2.
